summary: Completed the bounded operating research for Creality from three current HKEX filings and published a linked security page with three analytical charts. The evidence supports very high thematic exposure and the utilization-times-consumables mechanism: H1 2026 consumables revenue rose 48.3% while printer revenue was nearly flat. It also shows deteriorating margins, an adjusted loss, RMB257.0 million operating cash outflow, higher inventory, and strong post-IPO liquidity. The schema-version-two assessment could not be written because the deterministic current HKD mark has status error after Yahoo returned YFTzMissingError. Issue issue_8d02244761c17b61e377 records the candidate-specific blocker. No fair value, canonical rating, relationship acceptance, idea refresh, strategy, signal, order, allocation, execution, cash, portfolio, or performance state was created or changed.

evidence.claim: Audited revenue increased from RMB1.883 billion in 2023 to RMB3.127 billion in 2025; consumables rose from 7.2% to 13.4% of revenue while printer share fell from 74.6% to 57.1%, but adjusted net profit declined and 2025 operating cash flow turned negative.

H1 2026 revenue grew 12.9%, consumables 48.3%, printer revenue 0.1%, and cloud activity grew quickly; gross margin fell 360 basis points, adjusted net profit became a RMB15.7 million loss, and operating cash outflow worsened to RMB257.0 million.
Creality reported 477,854,151 issued H shares, no treasury shares, and compliant public float at 31 August 2026.

The repository retains a 4 September 2026 HKD26.00 close for security_b19e8f0343b7da1f3c03, but the current latest row has status error and therefore fails the mandatory assessment market-reference gate.
